final: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phase_stats), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_bandwidth, p.telescope_count, m.mean_bandwidth FROM phase_stats p CROSS JOIN phase_mean m WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth), SUM(telescope_count), AVG(avg_bandwidth - mean_bandwidth) FROM kept
